Settings.title: Account
Settings.timezoneDescription: Your weekly hours interpret in this zone. Slot times shown to visitors convert from this zone to UTC, then render in their local time.
Settings.languageDescription: Switches the labels and copy across the host surface. Visitor-facing pages negotiate from the visitor's browser.
Settings.themeDescription: Match the OS by default. Override per device when you want a fixed look.

Calendar.description: Connect Google or Outlook so busy times block your availability. Each connection lets you pick which calendars count.
Calendar.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No calendars selected} one {# calendar selected} other {# calendars selected}}
Calendar.providerNotConfigured: Provider not configured — set the env vars to enable.
Calendar.pickDescription: Busy events on the calendars you select count against your availability. Unselected calendars are ignored.

DangerZone.label: Danger zone
DangerZone.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently removes your handle, weekly hours, profile, and any upcoming bookings. Booking history is anonymized and retained for audit. There is no undo.
DangerZone.dialogIntro: This permanently deletes <handle></handle>, your weekly hours, and any upcoming bookings against your page. Booking history is anonymized and retained for audit. There is no undo.
DangerZone.dialogTypeEmail: Type your account email {email} to confirm.
DangerZone.emailMismatch: Email does not match the account email
